case_title: Dandu Jaggaraju v. State of A.P.
trial_court_outcome: Convicted under s.302, s.201 and s.379
neutral_facts: The accused, a relative of the deceased, was alleged to have taken the deceased under a pretext and thereafter killed her. The deceased, who was married against her family's wishes, left with the accused on the day of the incident. The accused was arrested later, and some of the deceased's jewellery was recovered from his possession. The deceased's body was found with signs of asphyxia. The prosecution relied on the last seen evidence of witnesses, medical evidence, and the recovery of the jewellery. The accused's family had accepted the marriage, and a child was born to the couple, which cast doubt on the motive. The recovery of the jewellery was questioned as it was commonly available, and the accused was found in possession of it for over a week after the incident.
